result.title: Final round of BE/BTech counselling (on Zoom platform)
result.summary: The partial document provides information about the final round of BE/BTech counselling for vacant seats at TIET, scheduled to be conducted online via Zoom on August 14, 2026. It outlines the eligibility criteria based on the JEE Main 2026 merit and provides a Zoom link for candidates to join the session. Candidates are instructed to rename themselves in a specific format for identification. The counselling schedule is detailed by category and JEE Main percentile, with specific times for each group. If vacancies remain after the scheduled rounds, additional counselling will occur at 2:30 PM, with vacancy details posted online at 2:00 PM. The document also includes a branch/category-wise vacant seat status and explains abbreviations for different categories.
result.text:
Final  round of BE/BTech counselling  (on Zoom  platform )  
  
Dated: 13-08-2026 
This is to inform all candidates who have applied for admission to the BE/BTech programme at TIET that 
the final round of counselling for vacant seats will be conducted online via the Zoom platform, as per 
the schedule provided in this notice. Candidates participating in this counselling must meet the 
eligibility criteria specified in the 202 6–27 prospectus available at https://admission.thapar.edu/ .  
In this round of counselling, all the candidates irrespective of their current admission status 
(admitted/not admitted/withdrawal) will be considered based on JEE Main – 2026 merit.  
 
Zoom link to join the counselling  
https://tiet.zoom.us/j/92158365622  
Candidates joining the counselling should rename themselves as 
‘YourName_TIETAppNo_JEEPercentile’.  Example: Gurjeet_123456_97.89  
Schedule  of Counselling  
Date: 14-08-2026 
Category  JEE Main – 2026 percentile  Zoom Meeting 
join time  Counselling 
Time  
SCST/SCO/STO  All eligible candidates  09:15 AM  09:30 AM  
General Category 
(Punjab and Outside 
Punjab)  JEE Main %tile >=9 5 10:00 AM 10:15 AM 
JEE Main %tile >=9 4 11:00 AM  11:15 AM  
JEE Main %tile >=9 2 12:00 PM 12:15 PM 
 
In case any vacancies remain after completion of all the above -mentioned rounds, the same shall be 
filled through counselling at 2:30 PM. The details of the available vacancies and counselling shall be 
uploaded on the website at 2:00 PM.  
 
Vacant Seat Status  
Following is the branch/category wise vacant seat status for this round of counselling.  
Branch  Category  
GENO  GENP  SCST/SCO/STO  
COPC  A A NA 
COBS  NA NA NA 
COE  A A A 
DSAI  NA NA NA 
EEC A A A 
RAI A A A 
A – Available    NA – Not Available   
 
Abbreviations  
 
Categories  
GENO  General (Outside Punjab)  SCST  Schedule Caste/Tribe Punjab  
SCO  Schedule Caste (Outside Punjab)  STO Schedule Tribe (Outside Punjab)

nodes.text:
Final  round of BE/BTech counselling  (on Zoom  platform )  
  
Dated: 13-08-2026 
This is to inform all candidates who have applied for admission to the BE/BTech programme at TIET that 
the final round of counselling for vacant seats will be conducted online via the Zoom platform, as per 
the schedule provided in this notice. Candidates participating in this counselling must meet the 
eligibility criteria specified in the 202 6–27 prospectus available at https://admission.thapar.edu/ .  
In this round of counselling, all the candidates irrespective of their current admission status 
(admitted/not admitted/withdrawal) will be considered based on JEE Main – 2026 merit.  
 
Zoom link to join the counselling  
https://tiet.zoom.us/j/92158365622  
Candidates joining the counselling should rename themselves as 
‘YourName_TIETAppNo_JEEPercentile’.  Example: Gurjeet_123456_97.89  
Schedule  of Counselling  
Date: 14-08-2026 
Category  JEE Main – 2026 percentile  Zoom Meeting 
join time  Counselling 
Time  
SCST/SCO/STO  All eligible candidates  09:15 AM  09:30 AM  
General Category 
(Punjab and Outside 
Punjab)  JEE Main %tile >=9 5 10:00 AM 10:15 AM 
JEE Main %tile >=9 4 11:00 AM  11:15 AM  
JEE Main %tile >=9 2 12:00 PM 12:15 PM 
 
In case any vacancies remain after completion of all the above -mentioned rounds, the same shall be 
filled through counselling at 2:30 PM. The details of the available vacancies and counselling shall be 
uploaded on the website at 2:00 PM.  
 
Vacant Seat Status  
Following is the branch/category wise vacant seat status for this round of counselling.  
Branch  Category  
GENO  GENP  SCST/SCO/STO  
COPC  A A NA 
COBS  NA NA NA 
COE  A A A 
DSAI  NA NA NA 
EEC A A A 
RAI A A A 
A – Available    NA – Not Available   
 
Abbreviations  
 
Categories  
GENO  General (Outside Punjab)  SCST  Schedule Caste/Tribe Punjab  
SCO  Schedule Caste (Outside Punjab)  STO Schedule Tribe (Outside Punjab)  
  
Branches  
COPC  Computer Sci. & Engg. (Patiala Campus)  EEC Electrical & Computer Engg.  
COBS  Computer Science and Business Systems  COE  Computer Engg.  
DSAI  Artificial Intelligence and Data Science  RAI Robotics & Artificial Intelligence  
 
Important Note  
1. Candidates who  have already applied will be considered for admission in this round of 
counselling.  
2. After offering the seats to reserved category candidates, vacant seats, will be offered to 
General category candidates.  
3. Candidates are advised to upload their JEE Main scorecard, 10+2 scorecard and reservation 
certificate (wherever applicable) in the application form.  
4. Candidates offered admission in this online round of counselling are required to deposit a fee 
within one hour  (once the admission is offered) on the day of counselling. If a candidate is 
offered admission and he/she does not deposit the prescribed fees by the prescribed 
date/time, the offer made shall be treated as cancelled. No correspondence or appeal in this 
regard will be entertained.  
5. Candidate can visit https://webkiosk.thapar.edu/Admission  to check his/her  allotted branch 
with Login ID as the registered email ID and password as the numeric part of the TIET application 
number. Click on “View Branch Allocation Status” after login to the dashboard.  
6. After making the payment, please make sure to make the entry in “Fee Confirmation Slip” 
available at https://webkiosk.thapar.edu/Admission . Fee will be considered as paid only if the 
entry is made in the “Fee Confirmation Slip”.  
 
Commencement of Session  
The academic session has already commenced. Newly admitted candidates are advised to report 
to the Academic Section of the Institute on Monday, 17th August 2026 . 
Hostel Allocation  
For Girls:  All the hostel accommodation is filled and no vacancy is available on the campus. 
However, Vacancy will be available wef second semester (January, 2026).   
For Boys:  Only 3 seater (Non-AC) accommodation  with attached washroom in hostel FRF/G is 
available.  Only 20 seats are available . 
Fee Details  
Fee payable (Including fee of first semester)  : Rs. 3, 55,000/- for COPC, COE, COBS, DSAI  
: Rs. 3,24,800/- for EEC, RAI  
         
Mode of Payment  
1. The candidate can deposit the fee using any one of the following modes.  
i. Online using your Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking by visiting the link   
https://forms.eduqfix.com/thapariet/add    
ii. Online using your Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking by visiting the link   
https://eazypay.icicibank.com/eazypayLink?P1=/QXDwbDYmH8fJlaL4JBpvw==     
iii. NEFT/RTGS to following bank account  
IFSC: HDFC0000116     
Bank Account Number: 50200045695947  
Beneficiary Name: Thapar Institute of Engg. & Tech  
Type – Saving Account  
 
2. After making the payment, please make sure to make the entry in “Fee Confirmation Slip” 
available at https://webkiosk.thapar.edu/Admission .

nodes.title: Important Note
nodes.summary:
The partial document outlines the admission process and related details for various engineering branches at Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology. It lists the available branches, including Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Computer Science and Business Systems, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, and Robotics & Artificial Intelligence. Key points include:

1. Admission Process: Candidates who have already applied will be considered for the current round of counseling. Reserved category seats will be filled first, with any remaining seats offered to general category candidates. Applicants must upload their JEE Main scorecard, 10+2 scorecard, and reservation certificate if applicable.

2. Fee Payment: Admitted candidates must pay the fee within one hour of receiving the admission offer. Payment can be made online or via NEFT/RTGS, and must be confirmed through a "Fee Confirmation Slip."

3. Session Commencement: The academic session has already started, and new students should report to the Academic Section on August 17, 2026.

4. Hostel Allocation: No vacancies are available for girls, but vacancies will open in the second semester. Limited non-AC accommodation is available for boys.

5. Fee Details: The fee for COPC, COE, COBS, and DSAI is Rs. 3,55,000, while for EEC and RAI it is Rs. 3,24,800.

6. Payment Modes: Fees can be paid online via specified links or through NEFT/RTGS to the provided bank account.
